boundary: The original function closes the two area geometries and repeated target-policy evaluation. Terrain blocking in the cardinal branch remains a map-service concern; the zero-size convention is retained only for implicit or special actions.
implementation_contract: Decode area size independently from maximum selection distance.
Collect every active unit on covered cells that passes the same target policy.
Preserve unit-slot scan order when constructing the target set.
Charge action cost once and resolve one queued effect event per collected target.
